schema.doc: Return the valaquenta.plugin/1 JSON schema, loaded once and cached.

params.man: the manifest, either valaquenta.plugin/1 or a bare valaquenta.engine-manifest/1
params.name: engine name used to back-fill id, name and entry; defaults to the manifest's own
params.path: manifest path; its parent directory name is the last-resort engine name

normalise.returns: the manifest as a valaquenta.plugin/1 dict

resolve_entry.doc:
Import a plugin's entry module and find its entry object.

For an engine whose guessed class name misses, the sole EquationModule
subclass in the module is used instead.
resolve_entry.returns: dict with 'module', 'class' and 'ok', plus 'obj' on success or 'error' on failure

validate.doc: Check a manifest against the valaquenta.plugin/1 contract.

params.name: engine name used to normalise a bare engine manifest
params.deep: also import the entry module and check the type contract

validate.returns: the problems found; an empty list means clean

PluginInfo.doc:
A discovered plugin.

:ivar id: reverse-DNS plugin id
:ivar type: 'engine', 'face', 'lens' or 'tab'
:ivar name: short plugin name
:ivar version: plugin version
:ivar path: path of the plugin's manifest
:ivar manifest: the normalised manifest
:ivar entry: the entry point, {'module', 'class'}
:ivar license: SPDX licence identifier

PluginInfo.scaffolded.doc: Report whether the manifest was machine-scaffolded and not yet hand-filled.

discover.doc:
Find plugins: built-in engines, then examples, then user plugins, then $VALAQUENTA_PLUGIN_PATH and `paths`.

The first id found wins, so a built-in beats a user plugin of the same id.
discover.returns: the plugins found, in search order

load.doc: Load one plugin by id or by directory.

params.id_or_path: a plugin id, or a directory containing manifest.json

load.returns: the plugin, or None if not found

upgrade.doc:
Rewrite the built-in engine manifests as valaquenta.plugin/1 in canonical key order.

The guessed entry class is corrected where it does not resolve.

params.write: write the files; False only reports what would change
